summary: Iteration 3 backend testing: notifications gate (hold/resume) + inspiration quotes (current/overview/schedule/CRUD). 13/13 pytest tests passed against public URL.
critical_code_review_comments: notif_gate.set_hold(True) uses setdefault('since',...) — if hold is already true and toggled true again, 'since' stays the same (fine), but blocked_count is not reset on re-hold (intentional).
routes/inspiration.py _ensure_table runs on every request (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + SELECT COUNT). Minor perf overhead; consider startup-time init.
GateIn POST reactivation only resends 'push' kind — modal broadcasts (kind other than 'push') are dropped silently. Documented behavior but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Inspiration quotes auto-seeded on first call (christian + secular pools). Test-created quotes were cleaned up. Gate final state: hold=false (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 covered ONLY the two new features this session: notifications gate + inspiration quotes. Do not retest news-reprise/heygen (iter 1 & 2). Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_gate_and_inspiration.py. Gate state reset to hold=false at teardown.
